claim_boundary: no-monsters diagnostic; no model; no MAP01-clear/combat/general navigation claim

decision.FAIL_DEOPT_NAVIGATION: release/death regression or paired median candidate-minus-baseline coverage <0
decision.HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_NAVIGATION_EVIDENCE: safety passes but exposure or coverage gates miss without paired median coverage regression
decision.PASS_BOUNDED_DEOPT_COVERAGE: candidate escalation exposed >=1 in >=3/4 runs; release failures/deaths 0; candidate coverage >= baseline in >=3/4 pairs; paired median coverage improvement >=2 64-unit cells; candidate revisit fraction <= baseline in >=3/4 pairs

harness_change_from_v1: one formal case per outer execution call
